title: Critters
note: The first region (G3, 2026-10-16): Larkhollow, Route 1, Brideswood, Cotton Tunnel and Kestrel. Route 1, Brideswood and the tunnel are Tuxemon's Spyder maps from clean tilesets; the two towns are laid out for this game (tools/game_maps/) from the clean sheets. Route 1's east half doesn't reach Brideswood on foot in Tuxemon's map, so the way on is its open north edge. The story and every line of dialogue are ours.

descriptions.agnigon: It's called a false dragon: it looks like a dragon, but evolved from a different line of reptiles.
descriptions.arthrobolt: It hates commanding its fellow NUT and BOLT, and usually runs away. Then no one instructs them.
descriptions.dune_pincher: It wraps itself in whatever is closest. In the desert, that's the shrouds of long-dead pharaohs.
descriptions.nut: In great ocean ships, thousands of NUT and BOLT provide power and hold the steel plates together.
descriptions.selmatek: Ancient desert kings kept SELMATEK as watchdogs and hunting companions. Now they guard the tombs.

refresh.why: 2026-11-05: a level 6 Vamporm against a level 6 Vamporm never ended, because refresh (healing_power 3.0, recharge 3) healed a full bar every few turns. Recharge 8: 1,000 mirror battles at level 6 all end (the longest 176 turns, the mean 20); recharge 3 left 16% unended at 2,000 turns.

thunderclap.why: 2026-11-06, E1 exhausted: the move exhausted unlocks is the Nut line's first ranged one, and at Tuxemon's power 1.25 and potency 0.75 the balance run moved Arthrobolt 13.4 points (31.6 to 45.0 %) and Nut 11.6. Power 1.1 and potency 0.5: Arthrobolt +9.6, within the 10-point gate.

mind_vise.why: 2026-11-06, E2 stuck: a weak blow that gives stuck every turn (recharge 1) was chosen in 54.9 % of its users' turns, past the field's most chosen move (Water Blast, 54.5 %). Recharge 2: see BUILD_PROGRESS.md.

signs.text: LARKHOLLOW. North: Route 1, then the Brideswood, then the old tunnel to Kestrel.

people.name: Mum
people.text: There you are. Sit a minute and let them rest. The grass comes closer to town every year, so come home whenever they're worn out.

people.name: Mum
people.text: Sit, they need it. The whole town's heard about the cave. Dr Wren's asking for you at the lab, and dinner can wait till you've seen her.

people.name: Mum
people.text: The note's off the pot. Sit down and eat. And then go and open that gate behind Ashe, in Dragon's Cave: let them all go home to the Reach.

people.name: Drover Lad
people.text: This is the drove road, and it's shut from this end. It opens when somebody's beaten the Warden. Go round by the road north.

people.name: Drover Lad
people.text: Kestrel's just up this road. Shame you can't use it. North, then the Brideswood, then the tunnel.

people.name: Dr Wren
people.text: A keeper at last! The wild's been rising, bigger critters, closer to town, every season. I need someone who can win the Kestrel Ring. Go north.
people.after: Kestrel's past the Brideswood and through the tunnel. Warden Ivy holds its plate. Win that, and I'll tell you why it matters.

people.name: Pip
people.text: I saw a critter made of FIRE, up on Route 1! Well, it was orange. Mostly. Mum says they never used to come this close to town.

people.name: Rosa
people.text: Critters love these flowers. Wild ones keep to the tall grass, up on Route 1. Walk through it and they'll find you. It's on the way to Kestrel.

people.name: Keeper Ada
people.text: A new keeper! Let's see what you've got.
people.after: Good match! Your critters will get stronger every battle. So will the wild ones, these days. Keep going north.

people.name: Keeper Ben
people.text: Hey! You walked right into my picnic. That means a battle.
people.after: Fine, fine. The Brideswood is north of here. Mind you don't get lost.

people.name: Keeper Ada
people.text: You beat the Warden? Then my critters have some catching up to show you.
people.after: They've grown, and so have yours. Captain Rook's at the Old Keep, past the tunnel's north passage. He holds the next plate.

people.name: Keeper Ben
people.text: My picnic's grown up too. Same rules: you walk in, we battle.
people.after: Have a sandwich. You've earned it. Then get on to the Old Keep: every year the grass gets meaner, and they know why.

people.name: Woodcutter Bo
people.text: We're cutting a ride straight across the wood, but the Warden's orders are to keep it shut till someone's beaten her.

people.name: Woodcutter Moss
people.text: No way through yet. Tom's by the tunnel end of the wood, south and east. Mind you beat him first.

people.name: Keeper Mira
people.text: The wood is full of night critters. I've caught the best of them.
people.after: Keep heading south, then east along the bottom of the wood. Keeper Tom holds the far end, and Dale won't let you by without beating Tom.

people.name: Keeper Tom
people.text: Nobody gets to the tunnel without going through me.
people.after: Go on, then. Tell Dale at the tunnel I said you're all right.

people.name: Keeper Mira
people.text: The wood's gone wild since the Warden fell. So have I.
people.after: Go on. The critters in the grass are bigger now too. Ask at the Old Keep why: they've been watching it longer than anyone.

people.name: Keeper Tom
people.text: Dale says you cleared the way to Kestrel and back. Prove it.
people.after: Right. Fair's fair. You're the real thing. Go and show Captain Rook, up at the keep.

people.name: Digger Bram
people.text: Rocks came down across the north passage years back. They're cleared now, but the Warden says nobody goes through till they've beaten her.

people.name: Digger Flint
people.text: We've holed through to the far ladders here. Dale will let the Warden's beater use it, and nobody before.

people.name: Digger Ash
people.text: Not yet. Long way round for you: east and down, past the sly one in the dark.

people.name: Foreman Dale
people.text: The way to Kestrel's not for beginners. Beat Tom in the Brideswood first, then we'll talk.

people.name: Keeper Iris
people.text: I'm studying tunnel critters. You'll do as a test.
people.after: Fascinating. Everything down here's twice the size it was when I started. Kestrel is up the far ladder.

people.name: Keeper Sly
people.text: You didn't see me. But I saw you.
people.after: ...I was never here. And Kestrel's not up that ladder.

people.name: Keeper Iris
people.text: I've been studying the north passage critters. Shall we compare notes?
people.after: Remarkable. The old keep is past the north passage, if you're going.

people.name: Keeper Sly
people.text: Still didn't see me. Still saw you.
people.after: ...Fine. I was never here. Again.

signs.text: THE KESTREL RING. Warden Ivy takes on any keeper who reaches her.

people.name: Drover Tam
people.text: The old drove road, straight home to Larkhollow. Only the Warden's say-so opens it. Win in the Ring, and it's yours.

people.name: Drover Lil
people.text: It's shut. Beat Warden Ivy, at the top of the Ring, then come and walk it.

people.name: Sam
people.text: The store opens next season. For now, there's only one thing worth buying in Kestrel: a win in the Ring.

people.name: Ringman Pell
people.text: To face the Warden, you face me first.
people.after: The Warden is waiting at the top of the Ring.

people.name: Ringwoman Juno
people.text: Almost there! Not quite, though.
people.after: Go on. She's watched every move you made.

people.name: Warden Ivy
people.text: I'm Ivy, Warden of the Kestrel Ring. You came all the way from Larkhollow? Then show me why.
people.after: The Kestrel plate is yours. Dr Wren will want it, but the answers are at the Old Keep: the north passage is open to you. So's the drove road home.

people.name: Ned the Post
people.text: Letter from your mum: "Heard you beat the Warden! Rowan's put the plate on the shelf. Dinner's on when you're home." Rook's at the Old Keep, by the way.

people.name: Ned the Post
people.text: Letter from Dr Wren: "One plate left that isn't mine. Ashe has it, at the top of Dragon's Cave. Don't dawdle: the grass reached our fence last night."

people.name: Ned the Post
people.text: Letter from Dr Wren, and it's one line: "Come to the lab. Bring everything." Larkhollow, the drove road's quickest.

people.name: Ned the Post
people.text: No letters today. Nobody's frightened enough to write! They say the gate's yours to open now, up behind Ashe. They say the Reach goes on for miles.

people.name: Ringman Pell
people.text: The Warden wants a rematch, and you'll go through me first. Again.
people.after: Up you go. The Warden's been training since the day you beat her. Get past her and the gate at the keep opens.

people.name: Ringwoman Juno
people.text: Back for more? So are we.
people.after: Go on. This time she won't hold back.

people.name: Warden Ivy
people.text: The captain of the old keep sent word about you. Good. I've waited for this.
people.after: Twice, then. The gate under the Old Keep opens to you: Dragon's Cave. Ashe, at the top, holds the third plate. There's no rest in there.

signs.text: Your old picture books. "The Little Keeper" is still on top, its corners chewed.
Something smells good. A note on the pot says: NOT YET.

people.name: Rowan
people.text: Off to be a keeper, then? Talk to Dr Wren in the square first, then it's the road to Kestrel. And mind Mum's flowers on the way out.

people.name: Rowan
people.text: One plate on the shelf: Kestrel's. Dr Wren says four would do it, whatever it is. The Old Keep's got the next, through the north passage.

people.name: Rowan
people.text: Two plates! Ned says the Warden wants you back at the Ring, and that's the way into Dragon's Cave. Ashe has the third, at the top.

people.name: Rowan
people.text: Three on the shelf. Larkhollow's is the gap, the one you've seen in the Rest House. Dr Wren's had it all along: go and see her in the lab.

people.name: Rowan
people.text: All four plates, one shelf. Dr Wren says they open the gate behind Ashe in Dragon's Cave. The Reach! Go and see it for all of us.

signs.text: Shelves of field notes, thirty years of them. Each year's page says the same thing: bigger, closer, more.
The machine hums. A card says: DON'T TOUCH. -W. Beside it is a drawing of a gate with four plate-shaped holes, and the word REACH.
Dr Wren's desk: a flask of something green and a book called "Types and Their Troubles".

people.name: Fern
people.text: Dr Wren's sent you on to Kestrel? A tip for the road, then: a move that suits what it hits does twice the damage, a poor match half.

people.name: Dr Wren
people.text: The Reach was shut a hundred years ago, and the wild's been backing up against that gate since. Four plates open it. Three you've got. Battle me.
people.after: The Larkhollow plate is yours. The gate behind Ashe will open for you now: the Reach. Let them go home. But tell your mum first.

signs.text: The fire crackles. It's warm in here.
Plates from every town in the region, and a gap where Larkhollow's should be.

people.name: Nurse Hale
people.text: Welcome to the rest house. Your critters are rested now. If they're all worn out in the Ring, you'll wake up here.

people.name: Hazel
people.text: I came through the tunnel last spring and never left. Kestrel grows on you. Mind, so does the grass: win the Ring before it gets any higher.

signs.text: ROUTE 2. West: the Old Keep. East: the north passage, back to the Cotton Tunnel.

people.name: Hiker Lowe
people.text: A short cut to the keep, and Captain Rook's men hold it. Beat Rook and they'll stand aside. South, then west, then north for you.

people.name: Hiker Wes
people.text: Keep's business. It opens for whoever beats the captain.

people.name: Hiker Fenn
people.text: The north passage opened and here you are. Let's see what the south grows.
people.after: Keep west. The old keep is past the grass.

people.name: Keeper Nell
people.text: Nobody comes this way. So you have to battle me.
people.after: Fair enough. Come back with a picnic next time.

people.name: Keeper Oswin
people.text: I train down here where it's quiet. You're not quiet.
people.after: Huh. You'd do well at the keep.

people.name: Keeper Brook
people.text: The squires at the keep turned me away. You won't get past me either.
people.after: Maybe you'll get past them, then.

signs.text: THE OLD KEEP. No one has lived here for a hundred years. Its gate opens on the caves beneath.

people.name: Squire Pim
people.text: This gap's the captain's own. Nobody uses it till they've beaten him. He's by the moat: go round by the east hedge.

people.name: Squire Lark
people.text: Beat Captain Rook, and this is your front door.

people.name: Hermit Ola
people.text: Sit, sit. Nobody walks this maze without a rest. Beat the captain, then the Warden again, and the gate here opens on Dragon's Cave.

people.name: Hermit Ola
people.text: Sit. You'll want it. Dragon's Cave is through that gate, Ashe is at the top of it, and there's no rest between. Come back when you're worn out.

people.name: Squire Wyn
people.text: A squire of the keep guards this grass. Today that's me.
people.after: Hmph. The captain's further in.

people.name: Squire Hal
people.text: Halt! Every visitor to the keep battles a squire.
people.after: You pass. The captain won't make it so easy.

people.name: Squire Tess
people.text: I'm on watch, and you're what I'm watching for.
people.after: Go on, then. The captain's by the moat.

people.name: Captain Rook
people.text: The keep has stood here a hundred years, and so have its captains. Show me your critters.
people.after: Well fought: the Keep's plate. My forebears shut the Reach, and the wild's been rising ever since. Warden Ivy will want you back at the Ring.

people.name: Gatewarden
people.text: Below the keep is Dragon's Cave. Only a keeper who has beaten the Warden twice goes down there.

people.name: Gate Guard
people.text: The old gate. The other side's the Reach, and it opens to one keeper holding all four plates. Yours is still in Dr Wren's lab.

people.name: Delver Kai
people.text: Turn back while you've still got critters standing.
people.after: There's no rest in here. Remember that. Ashe is at the top, if you still mean to go.

people.name: Delver Mo
people.text: I came down here to study the cave's critters. I stayed for the battles.
people.after: Fascinating. The deeper you go, the harder they get. Ask Ashe why: it's her gate they're all pressed up against.

people.name: Delver Ren
people.text: You can't see me in this dark. I can see you.
people.after: ...The Wyrmkeeper's at the top. She can see everything.

people.name: Delver Ivo
people.text: Almost at the top. Almost.
people.after: Go on. Ashe has been waiting a long time for someone like you.

people.name: Wyrmkeeper Ashe
people.text: Few keepers reach the top of Dragon's Cave. Fewer leave it the way they came in.
people.after: So it's you: the Cave's plate is yours. Dr Wren wrote to me about a keeper from Larkhollow. Go home to her lab: Dr Wren holds the last one.

signs.text: Jars and tins, each with a label in Sam's writing: TONIC, STRONGER TONIC, DON'T.

people.name: Sam
people.text: Open at last! Potions for the road, and a revive or two for the worst of it.

signs.text: THE REACH. East: the old way back to the Cotton Tunnel. South: the gate, and Dragon's Cave.

people.name: Nurse Hale's Sister
people.text: Rest here as long as you like. Every critter there is comes through this meadow sooner or later. Your Dex will fill if you've the patience.

people.name: Ranger Sol
people.text: A hundred years shut, and they're going home at last. The grass out there will settle now: you did that. Stay as long as you like, and catch them all.
